title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana: Last Date, Rs 50,000
meta_description: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana: Rs 50,000 for graduates, Rs 25,000 inter 1st div. Apply at medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Check last date and payment status.

hero.one_liner: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana gives Bihar girl graduates Rs 50,000 and inter-pass students up to Rs 25,000. Apply at medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Check the last date.

what_is_it: The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is a Bihar government scheme that provides financial grants to girl students at key educational milestones. The scheme covers graduation, intermediate (Class 12), and earlier stages of schooling, with the largest benefit of Rs 50,000 for graduation.

The graduation benefit of Rs 50,000 was revised upward in 2024 from the earlier Rs 25,000. This enhanced amount is credited directly to the student's bank account via DBT after the university verifies the graduation application on medhasoft.bih.nic.in.

eligibility.label: Graduation benefit
eligibility.value: Rs 50,000 for girls who passed graduation from a recognised Bihar university. Married and unmarried both eligible.

eligibility.label: Intermediate benefit
eligibility.value: For Class 12 pass: depends on division. First division qualifies for the higher amount. Unmarried condition applies.

eligibility.label: No income limit
eligibility.value: Open to all categories and incomes, no caste or economic restriction.

eligibility.label: Bihar university
eligibility.value: Graduation must be from a recognised Bihar university, including private affiliated colleges.

eligibility.label: Bank account
eligibility.value: Account in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded, active for DBT.

eligibility_filters.notes: Bihar girl students. Graduation Rs 50,000 from a recognised Bihar university (married and unmarried both eligible). Intermediate benefit for Class 12 pass, unmarried condition applies, amount by division. No income limit. Apply at medhasoft.bih.nic.in after the university uploads data.

how_to_apply.title: Confirm your university has uploaded your data on medhasoft.bih.nic.in
how_to_apply.description: Before applying, check that your college or university has uploaded your result data on medhasoft.bih.nic.in by entering your registration number in the status check section. For graduation benefit, the university must upload passed students' data. For inter benefit, BSEB uploads result data. If your name is missing, contact your college scholarship section and ask them to submit or correct the data upload.

how_to_apply.title: Check the current application window and last date
how_to_apply.description: Visit medhasoft.bih.nic.in and check whether the application window is currently open for your batch and academic year. The portal displays the current last date for submissions. Do not wait until the last date to apply — submit early so you have time to resolve any portal errors, document mismatches, or bank account issues before the window closes.

how_to_apply.title: Register and verify your details using registration and roll number
how_to_apply.description: On the portal, select the relevant benefit (graduation or intermediate) and enter your university registration number and roll number. The portal fetches your details from the institution's uploaded data. Carefully verify that your name, father's name, date of birth, and course details are correct before proceeding to the next step.

how_to_apply.title: Enter Aadhaar-linked bank account details
how_to_apply.description: Enter your bank account number and IFSC code and confirm the account is in your own name and linked to your Aadhaar. If your account is not yet Aadhaar-seeded, visit your bank branch first and complete the seeding before applying on the portal. DBT payments will fail if the account is not Aadhaar-linked, dormant, or is in someone else's name.

how_to_apply.title: Submit the application and save your application ID
how_to_apply.description: Review all details carefully and submit the application. The portal generates an application ID or acknowledgment number after submission. Save this number for checking your status, following up with your university, or filing a grievance if needed. An SMS confirmation is also typically sent to your registered mobile number.

how_to_apply.title: Track your application status and wait for DBT credit
how_to_apply.description: After submission, regularly check your application status on medhasoft.bih.nic.in by entering your registration number or application ID. The status progresses from 'pending university verification' to 'approved' to 'payment initiated'. Once payment is initiated, the Rs 50,000 (graduation) or Rs 25,000/Rs 15,000 (intermediate) is credited to your bank account via DBT.

extra_sections.heading: What Is Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
content: The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana last date for each batch's application window is published on medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Students should check the portal regularly for the current window's closing date, as applications submitted after the last date are not processed for that cycle.

The scheme is administered through the official portal at medhasoft.bih.nic.in (also accessible as medhasoft.bihar.gov.in). Universities and intermediate colleges upload student result data on this portal, and students apply against their verified records.

The graduation benefit of Rs 50,000 is available to girl students who have passed any graduation degree (BA, BSc, BCom, or equivalent) from a recognised university in Bihar. The benefit is available regardless of division — even pass-division graduates qualify for the Rs 50,000.
The intermediate (Class 12) benefit depends on the division obtained. First division (60% and above) qualifies for Rs 25,000 and second division (45% to below 60%) qualifies for Rs 15,000.

The benefit amount under the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is not linked to marks or CGPA beyond the division requirement at the intermediate stage. A graduate who barely passes (pass division) receives the same Rs 50,000 as a student who scores distinction marks.

extra_sections.heading: More Details and Coverage
content: Students should note that the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana application can be corrected if errors are caught before the last date. After the window closes, corrections may not be possible without filing a formal grievance and waiting for the next cycle.

Bihar's early-stage Kanya Utthan benefits at birth, immunisation, and school enrolment create a continuous welfare relationship between the state and families from a girl child's birth through graduation. These milestones encourage families to register children at birth, complete immunisation, and keep daughters enrolled in school across each successive stage.

Families who have consistently claimed the early-stage benefits from birth through school are likely already registered in the medhasoft system. When their daughter reaches graduation or intermediate, they can apply more smoothly as their family records are already known to the welfare delivery infrastructure.

extra_sections.title: Married Graduates Are Eligible Too
extra_sections.content:
A common myth is that married women cannot claim the Rs 50,000 graduation benefit. That is wrong. The graduation component is open to both married and unmarried girls.

The unmarried condition applies only to the Class 12 intermediate benefit, not to the graduation grant. If you graduated from a Bihar university, you can apply regardless of marital status.

extra_sections.heading: The Benefit Amounts by Stage
content: Third division and failed results do not qualify for the intermediate Kanya Utthan benefit.

The scheme is open to all categories of women students without restriction on caste, religion, or economic background. Both rural and urban girl students from any community can apply, provided they have passed the qualifying examination from a Bihar-recognised institution.

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana also covers earlier educational milestones for girl children, including benefits at birth registration, immunisation completion, and school uniform grants from Class 1 through Class 12. The graduation and intermediate benefits are the highest-value milestones under the scheme.
Students should verify the current eligibility conditions on medhasoft.bih.nic.in, as scheme rules can be updated across academic cycles.

The benefit is a one-time payment per educational level. A student who has already received the intermediate first division benefit of Rs 25,000 and later completes graduation is eligible to also receive the graduation benefit of Rs 50,000, as these are two separate milestones with separate entitlements.

extra_sections.heading: Who Is Eligible
content: The graduation application on medhasoft.bih.nic.in requires the student's university registration number and roll number. The portal matches this data against the university's submitted result data to verify that the applicant has actually passed.

Students can check whether their university has uploaded their result data by entering their registration number in the 'Check Status' section of medhasoft.bih.nic.in before starting the full application. If the data is not found, they should contact their college scholarship section with their roll number and request an urgent data upload.

Students whose names or other details are not matching on the portal should contact their college or university, as mismatches usually arise from errors in the institution's uploaded data rather than in the student's own application.
Universities play a critical role in the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana process. Each university must upload its passed students' data on medhasoft.bih.nic.in within the prescribed timeline.

BSEB students who passed Class 12 can check whether their results are available on medhasoft.bih.nic.in within a few weeks of the board's result declaration. Students should not wait for official communication — proactively checking the portal is the right approach once the inter window opens.

extra_sections.heading: The Last Date and Application Window
content: Students whose university has not yet uploaded data will see a 'data not found' message and must wait for the institution to complete the upload before their application can proceed.
The intermediate benefit application is processed through the same medhasoft.bih.nic.in portal. Students apply with their BSEB roll number and registration number from their Class 12 result.
The portal checks the BSEB result data to verify division and eligibility before processing the application for the Rs 25,000 or Rs 15,000 intermediate benefit.

Students applying for the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana must have a bank account in their own name that is linked to their Aadhaar. Joint accounts or accounts in a parent's name are not accepted for DBT under this scheme.

Women who completed graduation or intermediate several years ago may still be eligible to apply if they have not previously received the Kanya Utthan benefit and the application window for their academic year is still open. Students in this situation should check their batch's window status on medhasoft.bih.nic.in.

extra_sections.title: Watch the Last Date on Medhasoft
extra_sections.content:
The application window opens and closes periodically, and the last date for each batch is published on medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Applications after the last date are not considered for that cycle.

The window often runs for a few weeks only, so apply as soon as it opens and your university has uploaded your data.

extra_sections.heading: How Universities Upload Data
content: The bank account must be active and not dormant. A dormant or non-Aadhaar-seeded account causes the DBT payment to fail and requires the student to reactivate the account and then contact their university to re-initiate the payment.

If a DBT payment fails, the amount is returned to the government's account. The student must reactivate their account, complete Aadhaar seeding at the bank branch, and then request payment re-initiation through the university's scholarship section or via the portal grievance mechanism.

After submitting the application on medhasoft.bih.nic.in, students can check their status on the same portal using their registration number. The status updates from 'pending university verification' to 'approved' and then to 'payment initiated'.

Students should monitor their application status rather than assuming the money will arrive automatically. University verification is a manual step and sometimes takes several weeks, particularly near the end of application windows when submission volumes are high.

Applicants who receive rejection for incorrect bank account details should update their bank information through the portal or their university and request re-processing. Bank account rejection is the most common resolvable rejection type and is typically fixed within the same application cycle if caught early.

extra_sections.title: Your College Must Upload Your Data
extra_sections.desc:
You can only apply after your university uploads your result data to medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Until then you see a data not found message.

If your name is missing after results are out, contact your college nodal officer to upload it, then apply within a few days.

extra_sections.heading: How to Apply on Medhasoft
content: The scheme's grievance mechanism is available on medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Students facing persistent issues with rejection, status not updating, or payment not credited despite approval can file a grievance through the portal.
Grievances are routed to the district welfare officer for resolution and are typically resolved within a few working weeks of submission.

Name mismatches between the university's records and the Aadhaar database are a common cause of rejection. Students whose name is spelled differently in their mark sheet versus their Aadhaar should get the name corrected in one of the two records before applying.

The medhasoft.bih.nic.in portal prevents duplicate applications by checking the Aadhaar and registration number combination. Students who want to reapply thinking their first application was lost should check their application status using their application ID before submitting again.

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana graduation benefit is not dependent on the student's future plans. Whether the student pursues postgraduate study, starts working, or gets married after receiving the benefit does not affect eligibility — the only conditions are passing graduation and being unmarried at the time of application.

extra_sections.heading: Checking Payment Status
content: Students who are not comfortable using computers can visit a nearby Common Service Centre (CSC) for assisted application on medhasoft.bih.nic.in. The government process is free, though CSC operators may charge a small service fee.

Students can also apply using a smartphone on a mobile browser, as medhasoft.bih.nic.in is accessible on mobile. Having the registration number, roll number, bank account number, IFSC, and Aadhaar ready before starting makes the process faster.

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana benefit is separate from central government scholarship schemes on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Receiving the Kanya Utthan grant does not disqualify a student from also applying for central scholarships.

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is linked to Bihar's e-Kalyan welfare delivery framework. Students who have previously received school-stage Kanya Utthan benefits through ekalyan.bih.nic.in can expect a similar DBT process for the graduation benefit on medhasoft.bih.nic.in.

Students at private colleges affiliated to Bihar's recognised universities are equally eligible for the Kanya Utthan graduation benefit. Affiliation with a recognised Bihar university is what matters, not whether the college is government-run or privately managed.

extra_sections.heading: Distinct From the Student Credit Card
content: The sanitary pad benefit under the scheme provides Rs 300 per year to adolescent girl students in government schools. This benefit is distributed at the school level and does not require a separate application on medhasoft.bih.nic.in.

Students who complete graduation through distance or correspondence mode from a recognised Bihar university are also eligible for the Rs 50,000 benefit. They should confirm that their university uploads distance-education result data on medhasoft.bih.nic.in before applying.

Colleges and universities that do not upload student data within the required timeline may cause their students to miss the application window. Students at institutions with known data submission delays should proactively follow up with their academic section to ensure their data is submitted on time.

Bihar has been systematically increasing the monetary benefits under the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana across successive budget cycles. The graduation benefit was Rs 10,000 in early years, raised to Rs 25,000, and then to Rs 50,000 in 2024 to reflect the higher cost of higher education.

Postgraduate students who completed a master's degree after graduation are not separately entitled to an additional Kanya Utthan benefit for the postgraduate level. The Rs 50,000 is specifically tied to passing the first graduation degree, not to postgraduate or doctoral qualifications.

extra_sections.text: A girl from Muzaffarpur who passes her graduation from a Bihar university becomes eligible for Rs 50,000 under the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana. She does not need to visit any office. She applies at medhasoft.bih.nic.in, her university verifies the application, and the money comes directly to her bank account. She must apply before the last date of the current application window.

extra_sections.heading: Earlier-Stage Benefits and Eligibility Years
content: Bihar's female enrollment in higher education has increased significantly since the launch and expansion of the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana. The scheme created a direct financial incentive for families to support daughters completing graduation rather than discontinuing studies after Class 12.

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is distinct from the Bihar Student Credit Card scheme, which is a loan product for higher studies with deferred repayment after employment. The Kanya Utthan benefit is a grant — the student keeps the money and is never asked to repay.

Students who graduate in their final year should apply immediately when the portal opens the application window for their batch. Waiting until the last date risks missing the window if portal access is heavy or if document issues take time to resolve.

First-generation college students from rural Bihar are among the most important beneficiaries of this scheme. For a family where no woman has previously pursued higher education, the Rs 50,000 benefit after graduation serves as both a reward and a signal that education for daughters has tangible economic returns.

The medhasoft.bih.nic.in portal is available in Hindi and English. Students more comfortable in Hindi can switch the portal language to complete the application in their preferred language, and both language versions process the application identically.

extra_sections.heading: Practical Tips and Process
content: The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana graduation benefit reinforces Bihar's long-term goal of increasing female literacy and higher education participation. By attaching Rs 50,000 to graduation, the scheme makes completing a degree directly rewarding for both the student and her family.

Bihar's government publishes scheme updates and new application window announcements through the official state portal and the education department's official channels. Students should follow official sources rather than relying on informal or social media information for last date and window opening details.

Students should be cautious about third-party agents who claim to process Kanya Utthan applications for a fee. The application process on medhasoft.bih.nic.in is free and can be completed directly by the student or through a CSC at no charge beyond the CSC's standard service fee.

faqs.question: What is the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana amount for graduation?
faqs.answer: The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana graduation benefit is Rs 50,000, enhanced in 2024 from the earlier Rs 25,000. This is available to girl students who have passed any graduation degree (BA, BSc, BCom, or equivalent) from a recognised university in Bihar. The Rs 50,000 is available regardless of division, including pass division.

faqs.question: What is the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana last date?
faqs.answer: The last date for each batch's application is published on medhasoft.bih.nic.in and changes with each window. Students must check the portal for the currently active last date. Applications submitted after the closing date are not processed for that cycle. Apply early in the window to have time to resolve portal, document, or bank account issues.

faqs.question: How do I apply for Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana?
faqs.answer: Apply at medhasoft.bih.nic.in. First, confirm your college or university has uploaded your result data on the portal. Then enter your registration number and roll number, verify your details, enter your Aadhaar-linked bank account details, and submit. After university verification, the benefit amount is credited to your bank account via DBT.

faqs.question: What is the Kanya Utthan Yojana amount for Class 12 intermediate?
faqs.answer: For intermediate (Class 12), the benefit is Rs 25,000 for first division (60% or above) and Rs 15,000 for second division (45% to below 60%). Third division and failed results do not qualify for the intermediate Kanya Utthan benefit. Applications are made on medhasoft.bih.nic.in using your BSEB roll number and registration number.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana?
faqs.answer: Documents required: Aadhaar card, university registration number and roll number (graduation benefit) or BSEB roll number and registration number (intermediate benefit), and your own bank account details (account in your name, Aadhaar-linked, IFSC code). No income certificate or caste certificate is required as the scheme is open to all categories with no income bar.

faqs.question: Why is my name not showing on medhasoft.bih.nic.in?
faqs.answer: If your name is not found on medhasoft.bih.nic.in, your college or university has not yet uploaded your result data, or the uploaded data has an error. Contact your college's scholarship or examination section with your roll number and ask them to verify and correct the data upload. Once correct data is uploaded, you can proceed with your application.

faqs.question: How do I check Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana payment status?
faqs.answer: Go to medhasoft.bih.nic.in and enter your registration number or application ID to check status. The portal shows stages: pending university verification, approved, payment initiated, and payment credited. If your status has not updated for an extended period, contact your college scholarship section or file a grievance on the portal to escalate to the district welfare officer.

faqs.question: Is the Kanya Utthan Yojana only for Bihar university students?
faqs.answer: The graduation benefit covers girl students who passed graduation from a university under Bihar's jurisdiction or recognised by the Bihar government. Students from Bihar who attended universities outside Bihar are generally not covered, as the scheme works through Bihar university data uploads on medhasoft.bih.nic.in. Students at outstation universities should check with their DWO.

faqs.question: Is the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana a loan or a grant?
faqs.answer: It is a grant, not a loan. The Rs 50,000 (graduation), Rs 25,000 (inter 1st division), or Rs 15,000 (inter 2nd division) is given as a one-time financial grant. No repayment is ever required. This is separate from the Bihar Student Credit Card scheme, which is a loan for higher education with deferred repayment.

faqs.question: What is the Kanya Utthan Yojana marriage condition?
faqs.answer: For the graduation benefit, the applicant must be unmarried at the time of applying. This condition was designed to incentivise girls to complete graduation before marriage. Students should verify the current condition on medhasoft.bih.nic.in or official Bihar government notifications, as scheme rules can be updated. The intermediate benefit does not have a marriage condition.
